name: Clone Caller
tagline: AI voice agents that book meetings while you sleep.
services: AI Agents, Voice AI, SaaS Platform
about: Clone Caller is an AI voice-agent platform for outbound sales. Teams upload their leads, and human-like AI callers handle the outreach — calling, qualifying, and booking meetings straight into the sales team's calendar, 24/7.
It's positioned as a lower-cost, always-on alternative to hiring and managing a team of human SDRs.
challenge: Outbound calling is expensive and hard to scale — SDR teams are costly to hire, ramp, and retain.
Voice AI has to sound natural and respond in real time, or prospects hang up within seconds.
Qualification logic differs for every customer, so agents had to be configurable without code.
Booked meetings needed to land reliably in real calendars, with no double-bookings.

timeline.body: Mapped the SDR workflow, qualification criteria, and call outcomes worth automating.
Built a low-latency calling loop and tuned voices and turn-taking on real scripts.
Lead upload, campaign setup, call logs, calendar booking, and the admin console.
Monitored live calls, refined prompts, and improved conversion of calls to meetings.

approach: Designed a real-time voice pipeline (speech-to-text → LLM → text-to-speech) optimised for low latency.
Made qualification flows configurable per campaign, so each customer can define what a good lead is.
Connected calendar booking so qualified prospects pick a slot during the call.
Logged every call with transcript and outcome for review, coaching, and compliance.

features.title: Human-like AI callers
features.body: Natural voices with real-time turn-taking that handle objections and questions.

features.title: Lead qualification
features.body: Configurable criteria that score and route prospects during the conversation.

features.title: Automatic booking
features.body: Qualified leads are booked straight into the sales team's calendar.

features.title: Call analytics
features.body: Transcripts, outcomes, and campaign performance in one dashboard.

results: Outbound calling runs around the clock without adding headcount.
Sales teams spend their time on booked meetings, not cold dials.
A self-serve SaaS that customers launch campaigns on in minutes.

card.summary: AI voice-agent platform that cold-calls leads, qualifies them, and books meetings automatically — a lower-cost, always-on replacement for human SDRs.

name: Mural Link
tagline: Participant management for global clinical trials.
about: Mural Link is Mural Health's participant-management platform for clinical trials. It helps trial sites look after participants end to end — fee-free global payments, travel coordination, and communication between sites and participants.
Techknock Labs worked on the platform's web application, including the staging environment used for QA.
challenge: Trial participants are spread across countries, currencies, and payment methods.
Sites juggle stipends, travel bookings, and messages across disconnected tools.
Clinical data and participant details demand strict privacy and access control.
The product had to be simple enough for busy site staff with minimal training.

timeline.body: Worked with the product team on site and participant journeys.
Designed role-based flows for sites, sponsors, and participants.
Delivered payments, travel, and messaging modules in weekly increments.
Staging environment, regression testing, and continuous releases.

approach: Built a single-page React application with clear, role-based workspaces.
Integrated global, fee-free payouts so participants are reimbursed quickly.
Added travel coordination and secure messaging inside the same platform.
Set up a dedicated staging environment so every release is QA'd before production.

features.title: Global payments
features.body: Fee-free stipends and reimbursements to participants worldwide.

features.title: Travel coordination
features.body: Book and manage participant travel for site visits.

features.title: Site–participant messaging
features.body: Secure communication between trial sites and participants.

features.title: Role-based access
features.body: Separate, permissioned views for sites, sponsors, and admins.

results: One platform replaces the spreadsheets and point tools sites relied on.
Participants get paid faster, which supports retention across a trial.
A QA-first release process that keeps a regulated product stable.

card.summary: Participant-management platform for clinical trials by Mural Health — fee-free global payments, travel coordination, and site-to-participant communication.

name: Secure Living
tagline: Property management, simplified for Kenyan landlords.
about: Secure Living is a property-management platform built for landlords in Kenya. It covers the whole rental lifecycle — tenant onboarding, rent collection, compliance, and portfolio analytics — in one secure place.
Rent is collected through escrow-backed M-Pesa payments, the way most Kenyan tenants already prefer to pay.
challenge: Landlords were collecting rent manually and chasing late payments by phone.
Trust between tenants and landlords is low without a neutral payment layer.
KYC and compliance checks were paper-based and slow.
Owners with several properties had no single view of occupancy and income.

timeline.body: Interviewed landlords and mapped the rental lifecycle in the Kenyan market.
Designed landlord, tenant, and admin journeys and the escrow payment flow.
Onboarding, M-Pesa integration, KYC, and analytics dashboards.
Production release on Vercel with monitoring and iteration.

approach: Built a fast Next.js web app deployed on Vercel.
Integrated M-Pesa with escrow, so funds are protected until conditions are met.
Digitised tenant onboarding and KYC with verified listings.
Designed portfolio analytics that show occupancy, arrears, and income at a glance.

features.title: Tenant onboarding
features.body: Digital applications, verification, and lease setup.

features.title: Escrow-backed M-Pesa rent
features.body: Secure rent collection with automatic reconciliation.

features.title: KYC & compliance
features.body: Identity checks and records built into the workflow.

features.title: Portfolio analytics
features.body: Occupancy, arrears, and income across every property.

results: Rent collection moved from manual follow-ups to automated payments.
Escrow builds trust between landlords and tenants.
Landlords manage their whole portfolio from one dashboard.

card.summary: Property-management platform for Kenyan landlords — tenant onboarding, escrow-backed M-Pesa rent collection, KYC/compliance, and portfolio analytics.

name: CrossMyPart
tagline: Find, compare, and source electronic components.
services: Web Application, System Integration, Data Pipelines
about: CrossMyPart is an electronic-components search and BOM-sourcing tool. Engineers and buyers find the exact part, a compatible alternative, or a cross-reference — each with a transparent match score — alongside live pricing.
Once a bill of materials is sourced, CrossMyPart creates purchase orders automatically in Odoo ERP.
challenge: Finding equivalent parts across manufacturers is slow, manual, and error-prone.
Pricing and stock change constantly across distributors.
Sourcing a full BOM meant copy-pasting between spreadsheets, supplier sites, and the ERP.
Some distributor catalogues have no public API to integrate with.

timeline.body: Mapped the sourcing workflow and the data each step needs.
DigiKey API integration and a Playwright indexer for the LCSC catalogue.
Search, match scoring, BOM upload, and cart.
Automatic Odoo purchase orders over JSON-RPC.

approach: Indexed over a million parts by combining the DigiKey API with a Playwright-based LCSC indexer.
Built a match-scoring engine that explains why a part is a good cross-reference.
Added BOM upload (CSV/Excel) so a full build can be sourced in one pass.
Connected Odoo ERP so sourced BOMs become purchase orders automatically.

features.title: Cross-reference search
features.body: Exact, compatible, and alternative parts with a transparent match score.

features.title: Live pricing
features.body: Real-time DigiKey and LCSC pricing and stock.

features.title: BOM sourcing
features.body: Upload a bill of materials and source every line at once.

features.title: Odoo purchase orders
features.body: Sourced parts become POs in the ERP automatically.

results: A catalogue of over a million parts, searchable in seconds.
BOM sourcing that used to take hours now takes minutes.
No more re-keying orders between sourcing tools and the ERP.

card.summary: Electronic-components search and BOM-sourcing tool — cross-reference parts with a transparent match score, live DigiKey/LCSC pricing, and automatic Odoo purchase orders.

name: Plan AI
tagline: AI property intelligence for owners and contractors.
services: Custom AI Application, Marketplace, Web Application
about: Plan AI combines zoning intelligence, AI cost estimation, and contractor matching to help owners make smarter property decisions in minutes, not months.
The platform has two sides: owners analyse renovation potential and post projects, and contractors find work and bid through a dedicated portal.
challenge: Owners struggle to understand what they can build and what it will cost.
Zoning rules are complex and vary by location.
Matching owners with trustworthy contractors is slow and opaque.
Two very different user types needed their own experience in one product.

timeline.body: Defined owner and contractor journeys and the AI analysis outputs.
Renovation analysis and zoning lookups validated on real properties.
Owner and contractor portals, projects, and bidding.
Improving estimate quality and marketplace flow.

approach: Built instant renovation analysis that turns property details into recommendations.
Added zoning intelligence so owners see permitted options before they spend.
Created a bid marketplace with separate, role-based owner and contractor accounts.
Kept the experience simple: from property to plan to bids in a few steps.

features.title: Instant renovation analysis
features.body: AI-generated recommendations and cost estimates.

features.title: Zoning intelligence
features.body: Know what you can build before committing budget.

features.title: Plan & bid marketplace
features.body: Owners post projects; vetted contractors bid.

features.title: Dual portals
features.body: Dedicated workspaces for owners and contractors.

results: Owners go from idea to costed plan in minutes.
Contractors get a steady pipeline of qualified projects.
One platform for analysis, planning, and hiring.

card.summary: AI property-intelligence platform connecting owners with contractors — instant renovation analysis, zoning intelligence, and a bid marketplace with separate owner and contractor portals.

name: Just Travel
tagline: Trip planning as a conversation, on web and mobile.
services: Mobile App, Custom AI Application, Integrations
about: Just Travel reimagines trip planning as a dialogue instead of a form. Instead of juggling tabs for flights, hotels, and local tips, travellers talk to JustMine — an AI travel companion powered by Google Gemini — to shape their trip.
When the plan is ready, travellers move straight into search and booking flows backed by industry travel APIs, on the web or in the mobile app.
challenge: Planning a trip means hopping between many sites and tabs.
Traditional search forms don't capture what travellers actually want.
AI suggestions are only useful if they connect to real, bookable inventory.
Travellers expect the same experience on their phone as on desktop.

timeline.body: Mapped the planning journey and where conversation beats forms.
Built JustMine on Google Gemini with travel-specific context.
Flight and hotel search and booking via industry APIs.
Mobile app experience and production launch.

approach: Designed a conversational planner that turns a chat into a structured itinerary.
Grounded AI suggestions in live flight and hotel inventory.
Built a robust Laravel and MySQL backend for search and bookings.
Delivered a consistent experience across the web app and the mobile app.

features.title: JustMine AI companion
features.body: A Gemini-powered assistant that plans trips through conversation.

features.title: Flights & hotels
features.body: Search and book real inventory through industry APIs.

features.title: Smart itineraries
features.body: Plans that adapt as the conversation evolves.

features.title: Web + mobile
features.body: Plan on desktop, continue on your phone.

results: Travellers plan and book in one place instead of ten tabs.
AI suggestions are always tied to bookable options.
A seamless experience across web and mobile.

card.summary: Trip planning as a dialogue instead of a form — travellers shape their trip with JustMine, a Gemini-powered AI companion, then book flights and hotels on the web or in the mobile app.

name: StayNest
services: SaaS Platform, Custom AI Application, Payments
about: StayNest is an AI-based hotel management system with two sides: guests search, chat with an AI hotel assistant, and book rooms; hotel managers create and run their properties from a dedicated portal.
Payments run through Stripe, and managers see revenue analytics for every hotel they manage.
challenge: Guests want fast, natural search, not endless filters.
Independent hotels need modern booking tools without enterprise cost.
Availability, bookings, and payments had to stay in sync in real time.
Managers needed clear revenue insight across properties.

timeline.body: Defined guest and manager journeys and the AI assistant's role.
Booking flow, manager portal, and analytics.
Search, availability, Stripe booking, and the AI assistant.
Production release and continuous improvements.

approach: Added AI-powered search and an in-app hotel assistant for guests.
Built real-time room availability and booking tracking.
Integrated Stripe for secure payments.
Gave managers a portal to create hotels, add rooms, manage bookings, and track revenue.

features.title: AI search & assistant
features.body: Find and ask about hotels in natural language.

features.title: Live availability & booking
features.body: Real-time rooms, booking, and tracking.

features.title: Stripe payments
features.body: Secure online payment for every booking.

features.title: Manager portal
features.body: Hotels, rooms, bookings, and revenue analytics.

results: Guests find and book the right room faster.
Hotels run bookings and payments from one system.
Managers get revenue visibility across properties.

card.summary: AI-based hotel management system — AI-powered search and hotel assistant, live room availability, Stripe booking and payments, and a manager portal with revenue analytics.

name: A1 Renovations
tagline: Get an AI renovation estimate before you call a contractor.
services: Custom AI Application, RAG / LLM, Marketplace
about: A1 Renovations is an AI renovation-estimate marketplace. Homeowners upload a photo, describe what they want, and get a price estimate generated from a curated knowledge base.
From there they compare the market and place their project for contractors to bid on — a complete marketplace from estimate to hire.
challenge: Homeowners have no idea what a renovation should cost before getting quotes.
Quotes vary wildly, making them hard to compare.
Estimates from generic AI are unreliable without real pricing data.
Connecting estimates to real contractors needed a full marketplace.

timeline.body: Defined the estimate inputs and the pricing knowledge base.
Built retrieval over pricing data to ground every estimate.
Projects, bids, market comparison, and accounts.
Production release on Vercel and estimate tuning.

approach: Built a RAG pipeline over a renovation-pricing knowledge base so estimates are grounded.
Combined image upload with a text brief to understand the job.
Added market comparison so homeowners can sense-check every quote.
Delivered the marketplace on Next.js, Supabase, and Node.js.

features.title: Photo + brief estimates
features.body: Upload a photo, describe the job, get a price.

features.title: Grounded AI pricing
features.body: Estimates retrieved from a curated knowledge base.

features.title: Market comparison
features.body: See how quotes compare across the market.

features.title: Bidding marketplace
features.body: Contractors bid on projects posted by homeowners.

results: Homeowners start every conversation knowing the likely cost.
Contractors receive better-qualified, well-described jobs.
Estimate to hire, in one product.

card.summary: AI renovation-estimate marketplace — upload a photo and a brief, get a price estimated from a RAG knowledge base, then compare the market and place bids with contractors.

name: Archively
tagline: Protect your family, even when you're not there.
about: Archively is a secure digital vault for life's most important documents — wills, insurance, property records, and personal wishes — so they're available to the right people when it matters most.
Records are protected permanently, with blockchain-backed integrity for documents that must never be lost or altered.
challenge: Critical documents are scattered across drawers, inboxes, and drives.
Families often can't find what they need at the hardest moments.
Documents need strong security and proof they haven't been tampered with.
The experience had to feel calm and trustworthy, not technical.

timeline.body: Defined the vault, access rules, and release scenarios.
A calm, trustworthy experience for a sensitive subject.
Vault, sharing, and Supabase backend.
Solidity smart contracts for document integrity.

approach: Built a React front end with a Supabase backend for secure storage and auth.
Added Solidity smart contracts to anchor document integrity on-chain.
Designed controlled access so the right people get the right documents.
Kept the interface warm and simple for non-technical families.

features.title: Secure document vault
features.body: Store life's critical documents in one protected place.

features.title: Trusted access
features.body: Decide who can see what, and when.

features.title: Tamper-proof records
features.body: Blockchain-backed integrity for important files.

features.title: Permanent protection
features.body: Documents preserved for generations.

results: Families know exactly where everything important is.
Documents are secure and provably unaltered.
A sensitive product that feels simple and reassuring.

card.summary: Secure digital vault for life's critical documents — protecting your family's records permanently, with controlled release for the moments that matter.

name: Loadbetter
services: Web Application, SaaS Platform, Workflow Automation
about: Loadbetter is a warehouse operations platform that brings dock scheduling, appointments, and order tracking into one professional control centre.
Warehouse managers plan and oversee the day, while operators get a focused workspace for the tasks in front of them.
challenge: Dock schedules lived on whiteboards and spreadsheets.
Managers lacked real-time visibility of what was happening at each dock.
Carrier appointments clashed, causing delays and idle time.
Managers and operators needed very different views of the same data.

timeline.body: Shadowed warehouse workflows and dock operations.
Manager and operator workspaces and scheduling UX.
Dock visibility, appointments, and order tracking.
Production release on Vercel and iteration with users.

approach: Built live dock visibility so managers see every door's status at a glance.
Added smart appointment scheduling to prevent carrier clashes.
Tracked orders and shipments from arrival to dispatch.
Implemented role-based access for manager and operator accounts.

features.title: Live dock visibility
features.body: Monitor every loading door from one control centre.

features.title: Smart appointments
features.body: Schedule carriers without clashes or idle time.

features.title: Order & shipment tracking
features.body: Follow every order from arrival to dispatch.

features.title: Role-based workspaces
features.body: Separate views for managers and operators.

results: Whiteboards and spreadsheets replaced by one live system.
Fewer scheduling conflicts at the docks.
Managers and operators work from the same source of truth.

card.summary: Warehouse operations platform — live dock visibility, smart appointment scheduling, and order and shipment tracking, with role-based manager and operator workspaces.

name: BrainCity
tagline: Find the right course. Learn at your pace.
about: BrainCity is a multi-tenant learning platform where students discover in-demand courses, instructors publish and teach, and organisations (tenants) run their own learning spaces.
It offers a course catalogue, professional certificates, and administration tools for every role.
challenge: Three user types — students, instructors, and tenants — each needed their own experience.
Organisations wanted isolated spaces with their own users and courses.
The catalogue had to stay fast and searchable as it grew.
Admins needed fine-grained control without developer help.

timeline.body: Defined roles, tenancy model, and the learning journey.
Multi-tenant NestJS and PostgreSQL design.
Catalogue, enrolment, instructor tools, and admin.
Production release and new learning features.

approach: Designed a multi-tenant architecture with data isolation per organisation.
Built a NestJS API and PostgreSQL data model behind a Next.js front end.
Created role-based experiences for students, instructors, and super admins.
Made the catalogue searchable with categories and featured courses.

features.title: Course catalogue
features.body: Browse and search in-demand courses and certificates.

features.title: Instructor tools
features.body: Publish courses and manage learners.

features.title: Multi-tenant spaces
features.body: Each organisation runs its own learning space.

features.title: Admin control
features.body: Super-admin and tenant-level administration.

results: One platform serves students, instructors, and organisations.
New tenants can be onboarded without new code.
A scalable foundation for future learning products.

card.summary: Multi-tenant learning platform for students, instructors, and organisations — course catalogue, enrolment, and tenant-level administration.

name: EMR System
tagline: Electronic medical records for modern clinics.
about: This electronic medical record (EMR) system digitises how clinics manage patients — records, appointments, and doctor–patient interactions in one secure application.
Doctors and patients each have their own access, with clinical data protected by role-based permissions.
challenge: Paper and spreadsheet records were slow to search and easy to lose.
Doctors needed a complete patient history in seconds.
Medical data requires strict access control and privacy.
Clinic staff needed something simple enough to adopt on day one.

timeline.body: Mapped clinic workflows and record types.
Doctor and patient journeys and record layouts.
Records, interactions, and authentication.
Deployment and iteration with clinic staff.

approach: Built a Next.js application with a MongoDB data store suited to flexible medical records.
Implemented secure login and role-based access for doctors and patients.
Designed record views that surface the most important history first.
Kept the interface clean and calm for a busy clinical setting.

features.title: Patient records
features.body: Complete, searchable medical histories.

features.title: Doctor–patient interactions
features.body: Consultations and notes in one place.

features.title: Secure access
features.body: Role-based permissions for clinical data.

features.title: Simple to adopt
features.body: A clean interface built for busy clinics.

results: Patient history available in seconds, not minutes.
Records secured behind role-based access.
Clinics move from paper to digital without disruption.

card.summary: Electronic medical record system for clinics — patient records, doctor-patient interactions, and secure role-based access to clinical data.

name: Water Demand GIS
tagline: See how much water your area has left.
about: Water Demand GIS is a web mapping platform that models household water consumption against local supply. Users enter their daily water routine and see how much water would remain in their area.
It turns abstract consumption data into a clear, location-based picture that encourages smarter water use.
challenge: People rarely understand how their daily habits affect local water supply.
Water data is spread across sources and hard to interpret.
Results needed to be shown on a map, by area, to feel relevant.
The tool had to be simple enough for anyone to use.

timeline.body: Defined the consumption model and data sources.
Spatial data model in PostgreSQL and map layers.
Routine inputs, calculations, and dashboards.
Deployment and model refinement.

approach: Modelled water demand from everyday routines like showers, laundry, and cooking.
Stored and queried spatial data in PostgreSQL for area-level results.
Visualised remaining supply on an interactive map.
Built a simple sign-in and dashboard on Next.js.

features.title: Routine-based modelling
features.body: Enter daily habits and see their impact.

features.title: Area-level results
features.body: Remaining water supply shown by location.

features.title: Interactive maps
features.body: GIS layers that make the data easy to read.

features.title: Personal dashboard
features.body: Track and compare your water demand.

results: Water use made tangible and local.
A clear tool for awareness and planning.
A reusable GIS foundation for future datasets.

card.summary: Web GIS platform that models household water use against local supply — showing how much water remains in your area based on daily consumption routines.
